extra.abstract_snippet: This dataset comprises three complementary components for landslide analysis. (1) A legacy landslide inventory (legacy_landslides.tif) derived from the 1:50,000 landslide distribution maps provided by the National Research Institute for Earth Science and Disaster Resilience (NIED), Japan. The inventory was generated by merging the original polygons and represents long-term historical landslide distributions.
